text: is good with an inheritance: Or, as good as an inheritance, yea, better too
before thy time? Heb. not in thy time?
take no heed: Heb. give not thine heart
I applied mine heart: Heb. I and mine heart compassed
who so pleaseth God: He that is good before God
counting one by one to find out the account: Or, weighing one thing after another to find out the reason
